headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.4286). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 12 studies yielded an effect size of 0.97 (95% CI: 0.85–1.1), indicating no statistically significant association between green tea and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 74.55%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
